caveats: 2 of 158 labelled pair(s) contributed a different number of seeds from the modal 5 binary, 10 ternary, so their delta_iptm is a difference of differently sized minima. Reported rather than refused: the ROC refuses on this and is scoped to the Sievers arm, where every pair matches, while the fit spans the panel too (spec 4.8)
AUC 0.7173 is in-sample: the grid maximised it on the same 158 labelled pairs. It describes the fit, not performance on unseen pairs

lysine_reach_exposed_fraction carries weight 0.2857 despite having no validated discriminating power: BINMAN measured its reach window at or below chance (D-NOB-024). On this few pairs that weight is as likely to be noise as signal
